description: Gloster Meteor F.8 FAB 4404, long displayed on the airport access road, was refurbished (two months of repairs and hand-painting) in late 2024 and re-dedicated on 10 Jan 2025 in a new 1,000 m2 public plaza outside the Salvador air base gate. Photographed in place April 2025 (JetPhotos). Some press reports misprint the serial as '4004'.
